candidate_contract.mass_axis: candidate exact neutral mass within 10 ppm of explicit FBMN neutral mass
candidate_contract.reference_spectra: frozen GNPS Gold/Silver positive protonated library
candidate_contract.cross_adduct_task: queries whose best ion is not [M+H]+ are scored against the same protonated reference candidates

leakage_status: candidate construction read only feature identifiers, precursor/retention/ion annotations, representative spectral eligibility and the frozen library; phenotype and effect files were not read
claim_boundary: FBMN best-ion and neutral-mass assignments are phenotype-blind hypotheses, not definitive adduct identities.
Cross-adduct spectrum scoring is a harder real-application task and must be reported separately from [M+H]+ scoring.
This slice creates a fair candidate axis but does not establish any structure identification or biological gain.
